key: # Body names for {body} in audio/lonapse/phrases/*.tsv. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.
# key: lowercase stock bodyName (FlightSample.body), generic for every other body.
# spanish: written backwards on purpose. Lonapse reverses every word, so the clip says the real name
# ("nibréK" is spoken as "Kérbin"). Spelled for a Spanish voice: Jool is "luY" (Yul), Eeloo "ulI" (Ilu).
# generic stays plain Spanish ("el planeta") and is spoken as Lonapse like every other word.
# english: the subtitle text. Use "the" where English needs it (the Mun).
